BUT the fix is an EARTH EMBANKMENT: independent cut/fill probe (nat field vs road field) gives max fill 17.52 m (stormhold-helstrom @2240.3,1340.2), max cut 3.62 m (exceeds the tool's own 3.5 pass bar), 2537 sampled shoulder points above 40 deg, worst shoulder slope 70.6 deg. 1498 m of trunk has |offset| > 6 m.

roads.json declares 21 'deck_spans' (11 viaducts up to 16 m on stormhold-helstrom, 2494 m total) but NOTHING reads deck_spans in game/src — grep finds it only in tools/world/build-roads.mjs. The viaducts are JSON labels; the built world is solid fill.

ROAD GRADE: stormhold-helstrom (leg 1 of THE CROSSING) has a segment rising 19.63 m over 11.99 m horizontal = grade 1.637 = 58.6 deg. 638 m of trunk above 30% grade, 2231 m above 12%. Declared MAX_GRADE was 0.12.
